title: The names on the program
text: An old graduation program turns up with {teacher.first} and {classmate.first} beside your name. The day was shared with them, whatever came after.

choices.label: Keep it with my school record

outcomes.text: I tucked the program beside my report cards. One chapter ended; the people in it stayed part of my story.

choices.label: Cheer for someone at their next big day

outcomes.text: I remembered who showed up for me, and made sure to show up for someone else.
